items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: Oscar and I don't know, no friends.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I knew him. Well he ought to tell you he knew me too. Yeah, well.
Oscar and I don't know, no friends.
He told me he's from across the river and he knew a guy named Emmett Hardy over there. Emmett Hardy, sure. Did you know Emmett? Oh yeah.
